title: MacBook Pro 2012 Repair
subtitle: Refused to turn on or charge
description: No LED when the MagSafe charger was plugged in

PXL_20261023_121042280.jpg: Battery was dead and when I plugged in the MagSafe charger the LED did not come on.
PXL_20261023_124305691.jpg: Luckily I have another broken 13inch Macbook Pro from 2012 which I can use as a donor board. Going to try swapping the MagSafe DC-in power board and see if that fixes it.
PXL_20261023_122859520.MACRO_FOCUS.jpg: Just going to try swapping these and see what happens.
PXL_20261023_124633119.MACRO_FOCUS.jpg: Yup, that fixed the issue. That was easy
PXL_20261023_124654255.jpg: Love seeing the Apple logo appear again
